title: The $\mathbf{P}$-Completeness of Inverted Index Traversal: On the Complexity of Evaluating Boolean Query DAGs
abstract: arXiv:2601.18747v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern AI agents increasingly rely on search infrastructure to execute complex, neuro-symbolic reasoning workflows. These workflows often compile into deeply nested, non-monotonic Boolean queries over text fields. However, standard query evaluation strategies over inverted indices face severe theoretical limits when handling these structures. Stateful iterator models (Document-at-a-Time) are structurally bounded by $\text{NC}^1$ formula evaluation, suffering a worst-case $O(2^{|Q|})$ exponential blowup in query complexity when unrolling re-convergent logic. Conversely, recursive materialization models (Term-at-a-Time) incur an $\Omega(|U|)$ space complexity penalty (the Universal Scan) when evaluating logical negation over the document universe.   In this paper, we establish the theoretical boundaries of executing complex logic natively over an inverted index. We formalize a retrieval language ($\mathcal{L}_R$) based on Directe

translated_title: 倒排索引遍历的$\mathbf{P}$完全性：关于布尔查询DAG评估的复杂性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.18747v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：现代AI代理越来越依赖搜索基础设施来执行复杂的神经符号推理工作流。这些工作流通常编译为对文本字段的深层嵌套、非单调布尔查询。然而，标准的倒排索引查询评估策略在处理这些结构时面临严重的理论限制。有状态迭代器模型（文档逐次处理）在结构上受限于$\text{NC}^1$公式评估，当展开重汇聚逻辑时，在最坏情况下查询复杂度会遭遇指数级爆炸$O(2^{|Q|})$。相反，递归物化模型（词项逐次处理）在评估文档全域上的逻辑否定时，会产生$\Omega(|U|)$的空间复杂度惩罚（全域扫描）。在本文中，我们确立了在倒排索引上原生执行复杂逻辑的理论边界。我们基于Directe形式化了一种检索语言（$\mathcal{L}_R$）。
tldr: 本文首次证明了倒排索引上原生执行复杂布尔查询（特别是非单调逻辑）的评估问题是P完全的，并揭示了现有迭代和物化模型在查询复杂度和空间复杂度上的根本理论瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes that native evaluation of complex Boolean queries (especially non-monotonic logic) over inverted indexes is P-complete, revealing fundamental theoretical bottlenecks in query complexity and space complexity of existing iterator and materialization models.
